errors.expired: This sign-in attempt expired. Please try again.
errors.provider: {provider} didn't confirm your sign-in. Please try again.
errors.email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Log in with your password, then connect {provider} on your Account page.

account.title: Account
account.methodsHint: Connect the ways you want to sign in. You need at least one.
account.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {provider}? You won't be able to sign in with it anymore.
account.passwordHint: Sign in with your email or phone number and this password.

captcha.failed: The human check couldn't load. Refresh the page or try another browser.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.heading: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.introRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
twoFactor.settingsHint: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…) every time you sign in.
twoFactor.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key instead
twoFactor.codesWarning: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.disablePrompt: Enter a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code) to turn off two-step verification.
twoFactor.regeneratePrompt: Enter a code from your authenticator app to create new recovery codes. The old ones will stop working.
